page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-24-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 12 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 186 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 7.75 GB per vCPU. It includes 1343 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across four drives, and does not contain any GPU accelerators.

Benchmark results show top-tier single-core performance, with Geekbench single-core scores and single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression rates placing in the top 10% of tested systems. Multi-core performance is strong, as evidenced by Geekbench multi-core and image processing scores in the top 25%. The CPU architecture supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which contribute to strong performance in small-model LLM inference, achieving 394.37 tokens per second for text generation on a 135M parameter model. Memory bandwidth and database operations perform in the average range.

This instance offers a balanced, cost-efficient profile for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads by bundling high-speed local NVMe SSDs with a dense memory configuration. The combination of dedicated Intel Xeon cores, large L3 cache (504 MB), and fast local storage makes it highly suitable for database hosting, memory-cached web serving, software compilation, and localized data processing pipelines.
